query: As a physician assessing a 93-year-old man, among male ICU patients 88–98 with COPD exacerbation, what is the 75th percentile of distinct procedures in the first 72 hours? Compare mean ICU LOS and in-hospital mortality to age-matched ICU patients.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY num_procedures) AS procedures_75th_percentile FROM male_icu_patients_72h_procedures;
